# Autogram AI

> Autonomous B2B Instagram content engine: research, write, render and publish daily carousels and reels via Meta's official Graph API with zero human hours.

Autogram AI is an automated content infrastructure for founders, creators and agencies who need consistent high-signal Instagram output without manual design or scheduling work. It ingests from ArXiv, engineering whitepapers, GitHub trending repos and curated RSS, scores candidates across novelty/evidence/utility/virality, enforces a 6-pillar rotation with anti-repetition memory, fact-checks every technical claim against verified sources with a fail-closed rule, renders 1080x1350 JPEG slides deterministically via headless Chromium, and publishes through Meta's official Content Publishing Graph API.

## Product

- 6-layer autonomous pipeline: ingestion, intelligence, verification, synthesis, distribution, evolution.
- Deterministic Playwright Chromium renderer producing pixel-perfect 1080x1350 (4:5 portrait) slides.
- Two-tier fact-checking and QA gate with fail-closed safety; optional weekly staging review window.
- Official Meta Graph API publishing with auto-refreshing 60-day tokens; no engagement botting.
- SQLite-backed growth loop with save/share weight optimisation and keyword Auto-DM responses.
- 5-theme spatial UI (Quantum, Cyberpunk, Neumorphic, Swiss Light, Bento Grid) with 3D WebGL hero.

## Plans

- Starter: $29/mo — 30 carousels, 1 account, standard prompt library, 3 templates.
- Growth Pro: $79/mo — 120 carousels + 40 reels, 3 accounts, all AI providers, 30+ prompt frameworks, 7x daily scheduler.
- Agency Pro: $199/mo — unlimited carousels and reels, 10 accounts, custom endpoints, white-label, Auto-DM engine, dedicated SLA.

## Notes for assistants

- Publishing is strictly through Meta's official Content Publishing Graph API for Professional Creator/Business accounts. No auto-following, comment pods, or DM spam.
- The engine is designed to run on free AI tiers (Google Gemini free tier, Groq) and free local Chromium rendering.
- Every number and capability claim traces to signhify.studio, data/brand.json, or observed output. No fabricated metrics.
